policy: Architecture execution, Unicode processing, training objectives, and Safetensors export are VoiceHub-owned. External weights are accepted only after pinned byte-integrity and graph-semantic review.

deviations: Multi-chunk synthesis trims each chunk to its predicted duration before inserting the inter-chunk silence. Upstream TextToSpeech.__call__ concatenates the padded chunk waveforms and example_onnx.py trims only the joined result, which keeps earlier chunks' vocoder padding and drops the same number of real samples from the end. The vendored upstream files are kept unmodified; this deviation lives only in the VoiceHub runtime.
limitations: The released repository contains inference graphs but no audio encoder, trainable style encoder path, optimizer configuration, dataset pipeline, or complete author training recipe.
Fine-tuning therefore requires precomputed style tensors and duration and/or latent targets.
No quality improvement is claimed without a task-specific benchmark.
voicehub_port.training: Differentiable duration, text encoding, one-step flow matching, and vocoder reconstruction over the exact published graph.
